title: The Gender Pay Gap
question: Why does lifelong economic vulnerability still track gender lines across nearly every economy?

stats.label: Global median gender wage gap
Lifetime wealth lost globally to gender pay inequality
stats.source: World Bank Women, Business and the Law (2023)

stats.label: Projected time to close global economic gender parity at current pace

whatHelps: Mandatory salary transparency, subsidized universal childcare, and equal paid parental leave.
overview: The wage gap is not simply unequal pay for identical hours; it reflects the systematic undervaluation of care work, career penalties from motherhood, and occupational segregation into underpaid public service roles.
citations: World Bank Women, Business and the Law 2023
World Economic Forum Global Gender Gap Report 2023

title: Access to Clean Water
question: How does clean water access determine educational attainment, disease burden, and intergenerational poverty?

stats.label: People lack safely managed drinking water at home
People lack safely managed sanitation facilities
Spent daily by women and girls collecting water

whatHelps: Public municipal pipe infrastructure, watershed protection, and targeted community borehole grants.
overview: Water scarcity is fundamentally an infrastructure distribution crisis. Where municipal water networks fail, low-income families are forced to purchase price-gouged water from informal tanker cartels.

title: The Digital Divide
question: When education, banking, and public benefits migrate online, who is effectively locked out?

stats.label: People remain completely offline worldwide (~33% of population)
Urban vs rural internet penetration in low-income nations
Fewer women than men access mobile internet globally

whatHelps: Universal public broadband utility mandates, subsidized devices for students, and community fiber mesh networks.
overview: Digital exclusion acts as a compound amplifier: without internet, students cannot submit assignments, workers cannot access job boards, and citizens cannot register for social safety net entitlements.

title: Mental Health Disparities & Stigma
question: Why do mental health disorders carry severe economic penalties while receiving a fraction of healthcare budgets?

stats.label: People living with a diagnosed mental health disorder worldwide
Share of national health budgets allocated to mental health in low/middle-income states
Annual lost global economic productivity from depression and anxiety

whatHelps: Integrating mental health into primary care, parity laws for mental and physical health insurance, and workplace anti-stigma codes.
overview: Mental health conditions are disproportionately diagnosed among people facing economic precarity, housing instability, and discrimination, creating a self-reinforcing poverty trap.
citations: Lancet Commission on Global Mental Health

title: Child Education & Learning Poverty
question: What happens to long-term societal equity when children attend school but cannot read basic text?

stats.label: Children and youth currently out of school globally
10-year-olds in low/middle-income nations unable to read a simple text ('Learning Poverty')
Potential lifetime earnings lost due to pandemic and systemic school disruption

whatHelps: Free school meal programs, foundational literacy coaching, and eliminating school attendance fees and uniform costs.
overview: Education is the single greatest social escalator. When public schools are underfunded, children of the wealthy escape to private academies, cementing generational caste divides.
citations: World Bank State of Global Learning Poverty 2022

title: Food Waste vs. Chronic Hunger
question: How can one-third of all harvested food be discarded while over 700 million people go to bed hungry?

stats.label: Tonnes of food wasted globally in 2022 (~19% of all food available)
People facing chronic hunger worldwide in 2023
Share of all greenhouse gas emissions caused by wasted food

whatHelps: Cold-chain infrastructure in developing regions, supermarket donation mandates, and dynamic pricing for expiring produce.
overview: Hunger today is an allocation, logistical, and income distribution failure—not a crisis of aggregate global agricultural volume.
citations: FAO State of Food Security and Nutrition (SOFI) 2023

title: Road Traffic Injuries & Transit Equity
question: Why are pedestrians, cyclists, and transit riders bearing the catastrophic burden of automobile-centric design?

stats.label: Road traffic fatalities annually across the globe
stats.source: WHO Global Status Report on Road Safety (2023)

stats.label: Leading cause of death worldwide for children and youth aged 5–29
Traffic fatalities occurring in low- and middle-income countries

whatHelps: Vision Zero engineering: physical sidewalk separation, protected bike lanes, speed-calming roundabouts, and automated speed enforcement.
overview: Low-income pedestrians in developing cities walk alongside unlit, unpaved highways without sidewalks, bearing the mortal cost of private motor vehicle priority.
citations: WHO Global Status Report on Road Safety 2023
World Bank Global Road Safety Facility

title: Urban Housing & Eviction Precarity
question: What occurs when shelter is financialized as an investment asset rather than protected as a fundamental human right?

stats.label: People living in substandard housing or informal settlements globally
Share of household income consumed by rent in over 70% of major world metros
People worldwide living in absolute homelessness

whatHelps: Social public housing construction, tenant right-to-counsel laws, and progressive land-value capture taxation.
overview: When housing is commodified for speculative capital yield, low-wage workers are pushed to outer peripheries with hours-long commutes and high flood or fire hazard exposure.
citations: UN Special Rapporteur on Adequate Housing
